title: fix(ui): balance Connect logo with its label
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reduces the Connect lotus to 20px, or 24px in the large button, for better balance with the label.
- Bumps @pollinations/ui to 0.1.0-alpha.9.

Validation: 111 UI tests, typecheck, build, and approved light/dark playground previews.

gist.headline: A little less lotus
gist.blurb: The Connect lotus gets a smaller seat beside its label: 20px on regular buttons, 24px on large ones. Even flowers need spacing.
gist.summary: The Connect lotus in the app user menu shrinks to 20px, or 24px on large buttons, for better balance with its label; @pollinations/ui bumps to 0.1.0-alpha.9.
gist.impact: Connect buttons get a more balanced lotus and label at both regular and large sizes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Connect lotus as a small flower icon beside a button label on a cozy retro screen. Polli, wearing a tiny tailor's cap, checks their balance with a ruler; nearby potted flowers echo the lotus without implying a new feature.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny tailor's cap and measures a small lotus icon beside the word 'Connect' on a retro screen, with potted flowers and a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow against soft pastel gradients. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, sharing the frame, strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; chunky sprites and a little dark purple (#110518) contrast keep the scene emotionally warm.
